name: SuGaR / Gaussian Frosting
definition: Mesh extraction from optimized Gaussians. SuGaR: align Gaussians to a surface; extract via Poisson reconstruction. Frosting: bind Gaussians to mesh surface for hybrid render.
summary: SuGaR and Gaussian Frosting extract editable triangle meshes from 3D Gaussian Splatting, combining explicit mesh deformation with high-fidelity rendering via an adaptive Gaussian layer.
